metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.3 · 2007 · Death of a Ghost Hunter
metas.description: Renowned "ghost hunter", Carter Simms is paid to conduct a paranormal investigation of a supposedly haunted house. Along with a cameraman, a reporter, and a spiritual advocate, she embarks on a three night journey into terror.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 2.7 · 2016 · Haunting in New England
metas.description: A group of New England ghost hunters, who have been exaggerating their paranormal discoveries, summon an actual demonic force. The vengeful spirit follows them home, and won't leave until it has taken a few souls.
